This dishwasher is efficient, looks great, and has performed well over the last year. If I had to nitpick, I'd love the quick wash cycle to be a bit faster, but that's really a minor issue in the grand scheme. I'd highly recommend this model for anyone looking for a reliable, quiet, and stylish dishwasher.

All in all, we didn't see a big improvement from the old dishwasher, but it cleans the dishes very well, nevertheless.

Sentence (English): I got this dishwasher when my 15 yr old dishwasher broke.
Comments (English): [ Just Ok ] || ---------------- || I got this dishwasher when my 15 yr old dishwasher broke. Sadly, I liked my old one better. This Bosch dishwasher looks nice in my kitchen and matches my black appliances. It's MUCH quieter than my old dishwasher was. But I really dont like the layout of the bottom rack. The space along both sides of the silverware basket might as well be useless. It's only wide enough to fit small dessert plates or small bowls. I live by myself so it takes me about a week to fill my dishwasher. Therefore I rinse my dishes very well before putting them in. Knowing that I only run the dishwasher once a week is why I really wanted just the base model and didn't pay for a more expensive model. There have been a number of times where I still see food residue, (the little that there was), still stuck to silverware and plates. I would love to use the one hour cycle but I don't think it cleans well enough. And I think it's sad that a normal cycle is over two hours long when my dishes are fairly clean to begin with.

Comments (English): [ Bosch SPV4EMX24E 45cm built-in dishwasher ] || ---------------- || #opiniamotivowanapromojąWe've had it for two days. We managed to transport it from the store in a passenger car, easily set it under the counter, and plugged it in. The instruction manual requires patience, but it's understandable. Despite its 45cm height, it's not small. It has a separate cutlery drawer, foldable dividers in the lower drawer for storing pots, and an adjustable height for the upper drawer. It has an automatic tilt function at the end of the cycle. Our choice was based on the opinion of appliance service technicians, who cited Bosch as the most reliable brand, considering the current state of the market. A good start, let's hope it continues.

Sentence (English): I decided to buy a new dishwasher and chose Bosch.
Comments (English): [ The elegance of Bosch can be ruined by vandals. ] || ---------------- || I decided to buy a new dishwasher and chose Bosch. The robust and aesthetic appearance, along with the "Made in Germany" inscription, made me optimistic. I installed it quickly and will later supplement my review with the dishwashing results. It takes a while to understand all the programs and improve the Wi-Fi signal in the kitchen. Now, about the negative point. The delivery was very fast, but the damage is quite visible. This is demonstrative and deliberate vandalism during transport. The dishwasher was well packaged, but the vandals know where and how to hit it to cause visible damage. The packaging, very cleverly, includes two fairly thick protective wooden boards: one to protect the door and another behind it to protect the hoses. One of them, the one on the door, hit with such force that it broke it in half, and the sharp edges scratched the protective film and, at one point, ripped off the varnish from the door. It's surprising that, after such a strong impact, the door didn't warp – typical German quality. The enamel is transparent, so you need to look closely to see the stain. But it needs to be varnished as soon as possible, because over time it will rust due to humidity (I'll ask the manufacturer for a few drops of this varnish). However, after two strong impacts, the plastic corner of the lid has a large crack and the side of the machine has a considerable dent. The vandals didn't know my machine would be hidden inside the cabinet, so they wasted their strength. So, my final conclusion is: Amazon in Portugal needs to find a more civilized shipping company, and Bosch needs to pack its products in armored iron boxes specifically for Amazon.
Comments (Original): [ A elegância da Bosch pode ser arruinada por vândalos ] || ---------------- || Decidi comprar uma nova máquina de lavar loiça e escolhi a Bosch. A aparência robusta e estética, juntamente com a inscrição 'Made in Germany', deixaram-me otimista. Instalei-a rapidamente e, mais tarde, complementarei a minha avaliação com os resultados da lavagem da loiça. Demora um pouco para compreender todos os programas e melhorar o sinal Wi-Fi na cozinha. Agora, sobre o ponto negativo. A entrega foi bastante rápida, mas os danos são bem visíveis. Trata-se de um vandalismo demonstrativo e deliberado durante o transporte. A máquina de lavar louça estava bem embalada, mas os vândalos sabem onde e como bater para causar danos visíveis. A embalagem, muito inteligentemente, inclui duas tábuas de madeira de proteção bastante grossas: uma para proteger a porta e outra atrás para proteger as mangueiras. Uma delas, da porta, atingiu com tanta força que a partiu ao meio, e as arestas afiadas arranharam a película protetora e, a certa altura, arrancaram o verniz da porta. É surpreendente que, após um impacto tão forte, a porta não tenha entortado – qualidade típica alemã. O verniz é transparente, por isso é preciso olhar com atenção para ver a mancha. Mas precisa de ser envernizado o mais rápido possível, pois com o tempo irá enferruja devido à humidade (vou pedir ao fabricante umas gotas deste verniz). No entanto, após duas pancadas fortes, o canto de plástico da tampa ficou com uma grande fissura e a lateral da máquina com uma mossa considerável. Os vândalos não sabiam que a minha máquina estaria escondida dentro do móvel, por isso desperdiçaram a sua força. Portanto, a minha conclusão final é: a Amazon em Portugal precisa de encontrar uma transportadora mais civilizada, e a Bosch precisa de embalar os seus produtos em caixas blindadas de ferro especialmente para a Amazon.

Sentence (English): We started our newlywed life in a house we built in the countryside.
Comments (English): We started our newlywed life in a house we built in the countryside. Naturally, we lived without a dishwasher, clothes dryer, or robot vacuum, but since I am expecting a baby soon, I purchased these to reduce housework. (People around me call them the "three generations of aunties"—dishwasher, dryer, and robot vacuum—a whole new world! ^^) There is a reason they are called that. Even though it is the countryside, we live in an area where delivery services are unavailable in today's busy society. Now, I can efficiently do other things or rest, saving myself the time I used to spend standing around doing dishes for over 30 minutes after a quick meal! I am extremely satisfied with both the dishwasher and the dryer. The 6-place setting dishwasher is competitive enough that I didn't even need to compare it with other brands, making it an easy choice. The product was delivered on the exact date I wanted immediately after ordering. I am satisfied with the simple operation and the fact that it cleans thoroughly without any gaps; to ensure long-term, trouble-free use, I simply pre-wash the items before putting them in to run the cycle. It handles rice cooker inner pots and medium-sized pots with ease. The product's design is simple and stylish, so it matches my kitchen decor well. After much deliberation! I bought the latest model that includes hot air drying, and I think I made the right choice. #SamsungElectronicsEventEntry

Sentence (English): We recently had this Maytag dishwasher installed, to replace an old Whirlpool dishwasher that was around 20 years old.
Comments (English): [ Low Frills, but Great Cleaning ] || ---------------- || We recently had this Maytag dishwasher installed, to replace an old Whirlpool dishwasher that was around 20 years old.One thing that I was a little disappointed with in the beginning is the instructions - there is very little there. Most of the information is on a quick-start guide that is the front and back of one page. The rest of the booklet that comes with the dishwasher is mostly warranty info and safety warnings.This model doesn't have a lot of cycle options - there are Auto, Normal, and Quick wash cycles, with a PowerBlast option. There are are also High Temp and Sani Rinse modes, and Heated Dry can be set to Short, Long, or None. Auto is supposed to set the wash options for you, but it is not clear what kind of sensors it is using. It has always set the cycle to Normal with Short Heated Dry when I have pressed it. I have so far run all washes on Normal with no Heated Dry. With the exception of two bowls on two different washes that came out still dirty, everything has come out of the new dishwasher clean, and in most cases it is already dry despite not using the heated dry option. I am very pleased with the cleaning performance and drying on the Maytag. With our old dishwasher we rinsed everything before putting it in and we no longer have to do that. We used to wash anything really dirty or large by hand, and even still some things would come out dirty from the old dishwasher. Plastic items also frequently came out wet from the old dishwasher, but I only have to towel dry items occasionally with the Maytag, and that is without using the heated dry option.The cycles do take much longer than our old dishwasher - I think the Normal cycle usually takes around 2.5 hours. The Maytag is a little quieter than our old dishwasher, but it isn't silent - if you are in the same room you will hear it, and if you are in a nearby room without a door between you may be able to hear it there as well.We got the model in black, and I think it looks nice. With the exception of the controls, a small screen, and the recessed handle, the front is smooth - even the Maytag logo is hidden on the top of the door until you open it. On the inside, the tub is stainless steel and there are two racks. The racks are coated metal and plastic. The utensil basket is solid plastic. You won't find any adjustable items in this one - no stemware holders or tines that fold down. The utensil basket lifts out and goes back in easily. One thing that I like is that it is much easier to put rinse aid into this dishwasher than my old one - someone finally made a design that is easier to pour into.Overall, I think this dishwasher does a great job, and although it doesn't have a lot of features, I think it does the most important things at a reasonable price compared to the other options on the market.

Comments (English): [ Great capacity, convenient racks, quiet, but why wifi? ] || ---------------- || We bought and installed it yesterday, so I may update this review when I gather more experience. After some research in Consumer Reports we decided to replace our (not graciously aging) Kenmore with a Bosch for reliability, and this unit was in the reasonable price range and highly ranked by CR. Installation with the installation kit was fairly easy, although the mechanism for leveling by pushing the front supports with a screwdriver is terrible engineering (my old one had a screw that could be ratcheted). The whole idea of the reliance on wifi for the settings is also bad: it wasn't difficult to set up but it's an unnecessary aggravation. I imagine they save money on the controller and control panel this way. Will they maintain the app for the next 20 years? We'll see, my experience with LG and Kenmore on that front hasn't been good. Most of the documentation on how to run the dishwasher is also in videos linked through the app, the printed booklet is very thin and unhelpful, and while videos can be useful I hate having to watch for 10 min to find what I need. Other reviewers already mentioned the red "run light" projected on the floor (not mentioned at all in the printed documentation): it isn't subtle, and it isn't very informative, although it's fine to show that the very quiet dishwasher is running. I wish they had projected a timer (it seems some of the higher end models may do it). Make sure you watch the videos to understand how to reposition the racks and place the cutlery and dishes. So far the two loads I've run (on "auto") have come out nice and clean. I like the capacity of the unit and it is extremely quiet. The filtration traps are convenient to access and have metallic mesh. I'm not in love with the design of the door handle and its use of plastic. I installed the self-adhesive "vapor barrier" that came with the unit and hopefully prevents the bottom of the countertop (which is granite over wood) from gathering moisture, but I may paint the bottom wood later to seal it. Overall, I'm hoping for many years of service without failure. Bosch offers a 6 year extended warranty but it seems expensive: I would hope the dishwasher doesn't fail that quickly.

Installation with the installation kit was fairly easy, although the mechanism for leveling by pushing the front supports with a screwdriver is terrible engineering (my old one had a screw that could be ratcheted). The whole idea of the reliance on wifi for the settings is also bad: it wasn't difficult to set up but it's an unnecessary aggravation. I imagine they save money on the controller and control panel this way. Will they maintain the app for the next 20 years? We'll see, my experience with LG and Kenmore on that front hasn't been good. Most of the documentation on how to run the dishwasher is also in videos linked through the app, the printed booklet is very thin and unhelpful, and while videos can be useful I hate having to watch for 10 min to find what I need. Other reviewers already mentioned the red 'run light' projected on the floor (not mentioned at all in the printed documentation): it isn't subtle, and it isn't very informative, although it's fine to show that the very quiet dishwasher is running... I wish they had projected a timer (it seems some of the higher end models may do it). Make sure you watch the videos to understand how to reposition the racks and place the cutlery and dishes. So far the two loads I've run (on 'auto') have come out nice and clean. I like the capacity of the unit and it is extremely quiet. The filtration traps are convenient to access and have metallic mesh. I'm not in love with the design of the door handle and its use of plastic. I installed the self-adhesive 'vapor barrier' that came with the unit and hopefully prevents the bottom of the countertop (which is granite over wood) from gathering moisture, but I may paint the bottom wood later to seal it. Overall, I'm hoping for many years of service without failure. Bosch offers a 6 year extended warranty but it seems expensive: I would hope the dishwasher doesn't fail that quickly.

Replaced it with this Bosch - and this one is the poorest performing dishwasher of all.Installation was a pain because it doesn't just wire directly like previous washers. It plugs into a wall outlet, or you need to get an adapter box, or install an outlet.Noise level is good. I can hear the water being sprayed in the machine but its not disturbing. It at least lets me know its working.The door seems cheap and is a little flexible. My older washers had sturdy doors. If a child fell on it I felt like the door would be ok. If a child put weight on this washer door I think it would break off.One star on ease of use because Bosch is forcing using the phone app to use the washer.1) it doesn't clean very well when set to the 60 minute cycle.2) the regular cycle (2+ hours) does ok but dishes need to be precleaned in the sink. 3) Cycle options are very limited on the panel. Sentence (English): I like the appearance of this dishwasher, and it handles cleaning my dishes very well.
Comments (English): [ Serious Design Flaw in a Dishwasher I liked. ] || ---------------- || I like the appearance of this dishwasher, and it handles cleaning my dishes very well. Why only three stars. The dishwasher has a serious design flaw. It has two filters for food and debris. The one inside the cavity is easy to access, remove, and clean. It has very large holes that allow small pieces of food to pass through to the second filter which has a much smaller holes that can clog with food and cause the drain to clog and the circulating motor to overheat and burn up. This important filter is very difficult to access, and most homeowners will be unable to clean it. To access the filter, you must virtually uninstall the dishwasher from withing the cabinets and then engage in serious disassembly to access the filter. While trying to find out how to clean this filter, I've seen numerous reports of clogged drain lines and burned-out motors after a year or two (just outside the warranty period? ). J bought a Maytag because I expected a durable machine. I am deeply disappointed with this obvious design flaw. The only workaround I can see is to thoroughly rinse food from dishes before putting in the dishwasher. I have no experience with dishwasher cleaners, but I expect to be purchasing some of those soon for a monthly ritual. Note. The interior of my dishwasher and the first filter are sparkling clean. Sadly, I have no easy way to inspect the condition of the essential hidden filter or to easily clean it.Regretfully, I cannot recommend this dishwasher. I recommend that if you consider other brands be sure to determine how the filters are cleaned. Read lots of reviews. I have already sworn off LG and Samsung, but the list of manufacturers I trust seems to shrink daily. I wish I had known this before the date to return the product or extend my warranty through Costco expired.

Sentence (English): As a two-person household, I was previously using a small dishwasher meant for 3-4 people.
Comments (English): As a two-person household, I was previously using a small dishwasher meant for 3-4 people. However, I had to wash bulky items like pots, pans, and bowls separately by hand, which was inconvenient. Then, when I moved this summer, I bought an LG dehumidifier, and it was a whole new world. If you don't already have a dehumidifier, definitely get one. The satisfaction is liberation from dishwashing hell! Hooray! The three-tier design allows me to fit all the pots, bowls, and miscellaneous cooking utensils I use while preparing food. The height of the middle basket is adjustable, making it easy to place large pots on the bottom. The knife racks and the adjustable height of the top rail are also nice, allowing for more space for cooking utensils. I also ran it in the evening, and even though it wasn't on quiet mode, it wasn't bothersome. It was more like someone else's washing machine. The washing washes well, and for a first test run, I was very satisfied. It also has a download mode, and I heard the hot air drying feature is popular these days, so I'll have to try it out. If you don't already have a dehumidifier, definitely get one. The satisfaction is liberation from dishwashing hell! Hooray! I tend to buy large appliances when they're on sale, and I was previously satisfied with the price. I love spending time with my family after work thanks to the Saksegi and Rocheong. LG was a great choice.

Comments (English): A 14-person dishwasher with a large capacity that protects the happiness of newlyweds! We chose a 14-person dishwasher. A 14-person dishwasher offers ample space, allowing you to load and unload dishes that pile up all day long, as well as large cooking utensils, all at once, ensuring a clean and tidy kitchen. Perfect Design Harmony: This model is from the Objet Collection line, and as you can see in the photos, its clean, modern design stands out. We chose a calming Nature Beige color to match our kitchen interior, and it adds a sophisticated touch to our kitchen, making us very satisfied. Furthermore, this model embodies LG's cutting-edge dishwasher technology, delivering unparalleled hygiene and cleaning power. 100°C True Steam This feature is one of the biggest reasons I chose this product. Before washing, it sprays high-temperature, powerful steam to loosen stuck-on rice and oily seasonings. This allows for thorough cleaning, even with the least amount of manual washing required. 100"C steam also helps eliminate bacteria and viruses, so you can use it with peace of mind without worrying about hygiene. True Drying System (Hot Air + Auto Door Open): The dishwasher's homework, drying power, is also perfect. Hot Air Drying: After washing, it sends out hot air to dry the dishes fluffy. Auto Door Open: After hot air drying, the door automatically opens to exhaust the humid air inside and naturally dry the remaining moisture with the outside air, minimizing even water spots. Details for the convenience of newlyweds! In addition, the top shelf is great for storing cutlery and small cooking utensils, maximizing space utilization. I highly recommend it as the best wedding appliance that has greatly enhanced our happiness!

Comments (English): A 14-person dishwasher with a large capacity that protects the happiness of newlyweds! We chose a 14-person dishwasher. Perfect Design Harmony: This model is from the Objet Collection line, and as you can see in the photos, its clean, modern design stands out. Furthermore, this model embodies LG's cutting-edge dishwasher technology, delivering unparalleled hygiene and cleaning power. 100°C True Steam This feature is one of the biggest reasons I chose this product. Details for the convenience of newlyweds! Comments (English): [ Super quiet - even quieter than the previous Bosch ] || ---------------- || After a decade of solid performance, the previous Bosch dishwasher started kicking out E5 error codes. Frequent cleaning cycles and ensuring the filter was clear helped, but with the upcoming holiday and baking ALL THE THINGS (I love to bake, and practice mise en place when I can), plus potential flu season, I did not want to risk a dishwasher on the blink. I love to bake. And cook. I do not love heaps of dishes. Had a service call, and the tech advised it would be better to replace the machine. Sigh. I searched Consumer Reports and this was the top recommended model.I hunted around for the best price, and Best Buy was the winner. Having bought my previous Bosch dishwasher, plus two stoves and a dishwasher, (not to mention TVs, phones, computers and peripherals), I was very happy to purchase from Best Buy again. The process was painless and the techs that did the installation were great, as I've come to expect. This dishwasher has 3 racks, as the previous model did. What is different: the top rack has flex tines and the middle is a little deeper. Can put small prep cups there, plus my mini whisks fit nicely. The flex tines are great for thicker serving pieces/large serving spoons and whatnot. The middle rack offers more flexibility than the previous Bosch, again with more options for height and additional flex holders. The bottom is ok. I liked the bottom arrangement better on the previous model. But I expect I'll get used to this one in time. Just a matter of plate/pot placement.This model is even quieter at 42 decibels (old one was 48), and uses a mere 3.5 gallons of water. I couldn't possibly do that washing by hand. The top control took a bit of getting used to. Still haven't figured out if there is a delay setting, and I'm not sure about cleaning cycles. But it does have the sanitize cycle option (a MUST if someone in the house is sick), and it does a pretty good job at drying plastic items. Glass comes out sparkling clean, and I've got the raggediest hardest water. I'm talking descaling faucets quarterly kind of hard. But so far, this Bosch gets right through all of it with ease.

Comments (Original): [ 편리한 식세기이모님 ] || ---------------- || 1. 빌트인 설치 만족도주방 하부장과 자연스럽게 어우러지는 디자인 덕분에 설치 후 주방 전체 분위기가 한층 정돈되어 보였습니다. 베이지색 컬러가 과하지 않으면서도 고급스러워 만족도가 높았습니다.2. 넉넉한 14인용 용량3인 가족 기준으로 하루 치 식기를 한 번에 세척할 수 있을 만큼 넉넉한 용량이었습니다. 냄비나 프라이팬을 함께 넣는 날에도 공간이 부족하다는 느낌이 거의 없었습니다.3.세척력의 확실한 체감기름기 많은 그릇이나 조리도구도 잔여물 없이 깔끔하게 세척되었습니다. 스팀 살균 기능을 사용하면 세척 후 뽀득한 느낌이 확실히 느껴질 정도로 깨끗했습니다.4. 건조 성능의 향상자동 문열림 기능이 있어 세척이 끝난 뒤 자연스럽게 문이 열리며 내부 습기가 빠져나가 플라스틱 용기까지도 대부분 잘 말라 있었습니다. 건조 성능 면에서 특히 만족스러웠습니다.5. 조용한 소음 수준고성능 세척 코스를 사용해도 소음이 크지 않아 일상 생활에 방해가 되지 않았습니다. 밤 시간대에 돌릴 때도 크게 신경 쓰이지 않았습니다.6. 사용 편의성조작부가 직관적이어서 처음 사용하는 분들도 어렵지 않게 적응할 수 있었습니다. 다양한 코스가 있지만 자동 코스 하나만으로도 대부분의 상황에서 충분히 만족스러웠습니다.7. 청소와 관리의 용이성내부가 스테인리스라 물때가 덜 생겨 관리가 수월했습니다. 정기적으로 자동 세척 코스를 실행하면 내부 위생 상태를 유지하기에도 좋았습니다.8.전력 효율성에너지 효율 등급이 높아 자주 사용해도 전기료 부담이 크지 않았습니다. 물 사용량도 손 설거지보다 적어 장기적으로 비용 절감 효과가 있겠다는 생각이 들었습니다.9. 효율성설거지 시간이 줄어들어 저녁 시간을 좀 더 여유롭게 보낼 수 있게 되었습니다. 반복적인 설거지 스트레스가 줄어들어 생활의 질이 전반적으로 올라갔습니다.10. 총평디자인, 세척력, 건조력, 소음, 편의성 등 전반적인 완성도가 높아 만족스럽게 사용하고 있습니다. 가격은 다소 있는 편이지만 ..... 실제 사용 만족도를 고려하면 충분히 투자할 만한 제품이라고 생각합니다. 빌트인 식기세척기를 고민하시는 분들은 한번 고려해보셔도 될듯해요!
